title: Stick-It v0.8.3.2 — Finish the Flow
tldr: More expressive newspapers, better system-space feedback, smarter paste behavior, stronger zones and piles, and the complete Stick-It patch history inside the app.

title: Stick-It v0.8.3.1 — Finish the Edges
tldr: Polish for Done, Trash, Clippings, layering, and Shopping List attachment.

title: Stick-It v0.8.3 — Stick Around
tldr: Trash, Done spaces, richer scraps, reactions, layering and better media — your board remembers what happened to things.

title: Stick-It v0.8.2.2 — Touch the Paper
tldr: More physical controls, less menu clutter, and objects that behave a little more like the things they represent.

title: Stick-It v0.8.2.1 — Room to Breathe
tldr: Less chrome, clearer paperwork, and more room for the board.

title: Stick-It v0.8.2 — Get a Grip
tldr: More control, less friction: pin things in place, name areas of the board with zones, jump anywhere from a command palette, change your own keyboard shortcuts, and trim empty paper the way you meant.

title: Stick-It v0.8.1 — One Place
tldr: Settings finally stopped living in six different places: account, appearance, sharing, privacy, sounds and shortcuts now share one roof. Notes get a quick done tick and a way to trim empty paper, and the board gets a tidy-up button.

title: Stick-It v0.8.0 — Cut It Out
tldr: Photos can now be cut out right on your device, you can right-click the board to add things, and the corkboard gains receipts, tickets, postcards, photo strips and a bowl of alphabet soup.
